_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Du bis Speler {player_id} in Drië-spelers Tic Tac Toe.
Din symbool is '{symbol}'.
Du nump beurtelings din symbool op 'n 5x5 bord om 'n rie van veer te vorme.
Rieë kènne horizontaal, verticaal of diagonaal zin.
Dein zèt inzènde mèt 't format '[4]' um cel 4 aon te gaeve.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ongeldige zètformat. Gebruuk '[cell]' woa cell 0-{max_cell} is.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ongeldige celnummeer: {cell}. Moot tösse 0 en {max_cell} ligke.

game_action.placed: Speler {player_id} zèt hun symbool ({symbol}) in veld ({row}, {col}).
